description: Requests at immigration, customs and baggage are widely reported by returning Nigerians. Small individually, they are a levy on every homecoming.
energy_note: Paying a little, to enter your own country.

description: Groups returned involuntarily have historically arrived with no money, no documents beyond a travel certificate, and no reintegration provision - 'dazed and confused', as one contemporaneous report of 48 returnees put it.
energy_note: Landed, released into the car park, and that is the programme.

aspect: Returning is socially expensive as well
description: A return without visible success is read as failure by an extended family that may have funded the journey, which is why some people stay abroad in worse conditions than they would accept at home.
energy_note: Staying away because coming back would have to be explained.

description: Seven years abroad, a master's, and a suitcase. Immigration is unremarkable. It is the aunties at the arrivals gate, counting what he brought and not finding the car, who deliver the actual assessment.
energy_note: Cleared by immigration, assessed at the barrier.
